bluf: Iran launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, The Guardian World reported. Estonia said it would close all border crossings with Russia from December 1 after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker that Estonia blamed on Moscow; the Kremlin denied the accusation, France 24 reported.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Iran claims attack on US military airbase in Bahrain

disasters.text: GDACS reported a magnitude 5.5 earthquake in the Philippines at 13:41 UTC on 11/15/2026, potentially affecting 30 thousand in MMI VI.

items.text: France 24 and The Guardian World reported that Estonia would close all border crossings with Russia from December 1 after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker. Estonia blamed Moscow, and the Kremlin denied the accusation.
France 24's live headline said 600 Ukrainian drones targeted Moscow and a strike on the Crimea bridge halted traffic.
France 24 reported that Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia and Crimea across the Kerch Strait, limiting traffic, according to the peninsula's Russian-backed governor.
The Guardian World reported that Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan and Egypt condemned Iran's attack on Bahrain; the report said the countries were responding that morning to Iran's actions.
The Guardian World reported that Iran launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, further casting doubt on peace talks between Tehran and Washington.
